duration.doc: seconds visible; default lasts until the scene ends

x.doc: left edge in % of frame width (component default if omitted)

y.doc: top edge in % of frame height

exit.doc: animate out at the end of duration

layer.doc: data-layer id for the editor; auto if omitted

components.name: title
components.description: Kinetic headline with optional kicker and subtitle. Styles: rise (word rise), mask (line mask), slam (scale punch per word), chars (character flip), blur.

text.doc: headline; wrap a word in *asterisks* to accent it

components.example: component('title', { text: 'The ocean *breathes*', kicker: 'Tides', style: 'mask', at: 0.1 })

components.name: lower-third
components.description: Name and role bar that slides in with an accent bar, like a news or interview lower third.
components.example: component('lower-third', { name: 'Dr Amara Lee', role: 'Oceanographer', at: 1.0, duration: 4 })

components.name: callout
components.description: Label with a drawn leader line pointing at a point in the frame, with a pulsing dot at the target. Use to explain parts of an image, diagram or UI.
components.example: component('callout', { text: 'Tidal bulge', tx: 62, ty: 48, lx: 72, ly: 22, at: 2 })

components.name: highlight
components.description: Hand-drawn mark over an existing element: underline, circle, box, strike or marker swipe, drawn on like a pen.

target.doc: CSS selector of the element to mark

components.example: component('highlight', { target: '.headline em', kind: 'circle', at: 1.4 })

components.name: stat
components.description: Big animated number that counts up, with prefix, suffix, decimals and a label below.
components.example: component('stat', { value: 3.8, decimals: 1, suffix: ' cm', label: 'every year', at: 0.6 })

components.name: bar-chart
components.description: Bar chart that grows bar by bar with values; one bar can be highlighted.

highlight.doc: index of the bar to accent

components.example: component('bar-chart', { data: [{label:'2019',value:12},{label:'2024',value:31}], unit: '%', highlight: 1, at: 0.5 })

components.name: line-chart
components.description: Line chart that draws itself; series values over labels.

components.name: donut
components.description: Donut chart whose segments sweep in; good for shares and percentages.

size.doc: diameter in % of the short side

components.example: component('donut', { parts: [{label:'Ocean',value:71},{label:'Land',value:29}] })

components.name: progress
components.description: Progress bar or ring that fills to a percentage with the number counting.
components.example: component('progress', { value: 80, kind: 'ring', label: 'charged', at: 0.4 })

components.name: list
components.description: Bulleted list where items reveal one by one with icons; optional title.
components.example: component('list', { title: 'Why it matters', items: ['Longer days', 'Weaker tides', 'No more eclipses'], icons: ['sun','waves','moon'] })

components.name: steps
components.description: Process or timeline: numbered steps joined by a line that draws between them, each step lighting up in turn.
components.example: component('steps', { steps: ['Moon pulls', 'Bulge forms', 'Earth spins ahead', 'Moon drifts out'], at: 0.3 })

components.name: quote
components.description: Quote card with large quotation mark, words revealing, and attribution.
components.example: component('quote', { text: 'We barely know what lives there.', by: 'Marine biologist' })

components.name: image
components.description: Image from project assets with a reveal (wipe, iris, rise, zoom) and a slow Ken Burns move; optional rounded frame and caption.

kenburns.doc: end scale of the slow push

focus.doc: [x%, y%] point the crop centres on and the slow push moves toward (faces or subject from analyze_image)

components.example: component('image', { src: 'as_12ab34cd56', reveal: 'iris', x: 10, y: 15, w: 80, h: 55 })

components.name: clip
components.description: Video asset as a layer (footage, an engine-rendered clip, or an edited media output). Seeks frame-accurately with the scene. Transparent webm clips composite over the scene.
components.example: component('clip', { src: 'as_manimclip01', x: 0, y: 0, w: 100, h: 100, fit: 'contain' })

components.name: device
components.description: Phone or laptop frame showing an image or video asset, sliding in with a gentle tilt and optional screen scroll.

scroll.doc: screen scroll in % of content height

components.example: component('device', { kind: 'phone', src: 'as_screen01', scroll: 40, at: 0.3 })

components.name: cursor
components.description: Animated mouse cursor that travels through points and clicks with a ripple; for UI walkthroughs.

components.name: chat
components.description: Messaging thread: bubbles appear one by one with a typing indicator before each incoming message.

default.text: Did you see the tide today?

components.example: component('chat', { messages: [{from:'them',text:'Why are there two tides?'},{from:'me',text:'The Moon pulls both sides.'}] })

components.name: follow
components.description: Call-to-action pill (follow, subscribe, link) that pops in, gets clicked, and swaps to a confirmed state.
components.example: component('follow', { text: 'Subscribe', done: 'Subscribed', at: 3 })

components.name: particles
components.description: Seeded ambient particle field (dust, stars, snow, embers, bokeh) on a canvas behind the content.
components.example: component('particles', { kind: 'stars', count: 160, at: 0 })

components.name: light-sweep
components.description: Glossy light band sweeping across an element (logo, title, card) to add shine.
components.example: component('light-sweep', { target: '.logo', at: 1.2 })

components.name: logo-sting
components.description: Logo reveal: mark scales in with an overshoot, a ring pulse and a shine, then an optional wordmark slides out.

size.doc: logo size in % of the short side

components.example: component('logo-sting', { src: 'as_logo0001', word: 'AuteurFrame', at: 0.2 })

components.name: split-compare
components.description: Two panels side by side (or stacked on vertical) with labels; a divider wipes in and the winning side can be emphasised.
components.example: component('split-compare', { left: 'Spring tide', right: 'Neap tide', emphasis: 'left' })

components.name: character
components.description: Rigged 2D explainer character (vector, flat style) with procedural, frame-exact actions: idle breathing and blinking, walk/run to a position, wave, point, present, talk (mouth follows word timings), think, celebrate, shrug, nod, shake, look, sad. Actions can overlap and blend.

x.doc: centre x of the feet in %

lipsync.doc: 'voice' (film narration) or an audio asset id from speak: the mouth follows the real audio while a talk action runs, or all the time if there is no talk action

lipsyncAt.doc: scene seconds when that audio line starts

actions.doc: [{do:'walk'|'run'|'wave'|'point'|'present'|'talk'|'think'|'celebrate'|'shrug'|'nod'|'shake'|'look'|'sad', at, duration, to (walk/run target x %), dir (point/look: left|right|up)}]

components.example: component('character', { x: 20, skin: 'brown', hairStyle: 'curly', actions: [{ do: 'walk', at: 0.2, duration: 1.8, to: 45 }, { do: 'wave', at: 2.1, duration: 1.4 }, { do: 'talk', at: 2.4, duration: 2.5 }] })

components.name: mascot
components.description: Cute mascot (blob, drop, star or robot) with squash-and-stretch hops, blinks, talking mouth, look and spin. Good for kids, tips, brand explainers.

lipsync.doc: 'voice' or an audio asset id: the mouth follows the real audio

components.example: component('mascot', { shape: 'drop', x: 30, actions: [{do:'hop',at:0.3,duration:1.2},{do:'talk',at:1.5,duration:2}] })

components.name: sprite
components.description: Frame-by-frame sprite from a sprite sheet asset (for example a sprite-gen atlas). Give the manifest (asset id of its JSON, or inline) and a state; frames play at the state fps, looping, frame-exact.

manifest.doc: asset id of the JSON manifest, or a JSON object

grid.doc: [cols, rows, frameCount] when there is no manifest

moveTo.doc: x % to travel to over the duration

components.example: component('sprite', { src: 'as_atlas0001', manifest: 'as_manif0001', state: 'walk', x: 10, y: 60, h: 28, moveTo: 70 })

components.name: model3d
components.description: Real 3D model (GLB asset, for example imported from Polyfork) rendered with lights and soft shadow. Auto-fits and frames the model, plays its embedded animation clip frame-exactly, and can spin, orbit, float or enter with a rise or pop.

src.doc: GLB asset id (use import_model to get one)

clip.doc: animation clip name or index to play; empty plays the first clip if any

yaw.doc: starting rotation around the vertical axis in degrees

orbit.doc: camera orbit in degrees across the duration

lipsync.doc: 'voice' or an audio asset id: drives the model's mouth morph target (jawOpen, mouthOpen, viseme_aa) when it has one, otherwise a subtle talking bob

components.example: component('model3d', { src: 'as_glb000001', clip: 'Walk', x: 10, y: 10, w: 80, h: 80, spin: 0, orbit: 30 })

components.name: lottie
components.description: Lottie animation from a JSON asset, seeked frame-exactly with the scene (great for icons, stickers and UI micro-animations).
components.example: component('lottie', { src: 'as_lottie001', x: 35, y: 25, w: 30, h: 40 })

components.name: map
components.description: Animated real-world map built by the make_map tool (OpenStreetMap or Esri street, topographic, atlas, relief, satellite or terrain tiles, or Natural Earth vector countries). Plays the camera flight baked into the map asset and draws its routes, pins, labels and highlighted regions frame-exactly.

src.doc: map asset id returned by make_map

h.doc: height in % of frame (defaults to the box given to make_map)

tint.doc: colour treatment of the tiles; empty uses the one chosen in make_map

credit.doc: show the map attribution (required by the tile licence)

timeShift.doc: seconds to delay the whole map animation

components.example: component('map', { src: 'as_map0001', tint: 'paper' })

components.name: webpage
components.description: A website screenshot (from the screenshot tool) shown as a browser window, paper print or bare page, with documentary moves: highlighter sweeps, boxes, underlines or hand-drawn circles over phrases, a zoom into a passage, a scroll through a full-page capture, tilt and drop-in.

url.doc: address shown in the browser bar

highlights.doc: list of {boxes: [[x,y,w,h] in % of the screenshot, one per text line] (or box), at, style: marker|box|underline|circle, color}

focus.doc: {box: [x,y,w,h] %, at, duration, zoom} zooms the camera onto a passage

scroll.doc: {to: % of page height for the top edge, at, duration} for full-page captures

dim.doc: 0 to 0.6: darken the page when the highlights land so they pop

components.example: component('webpage', { src: 'as_shot0001', url: 'en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Moon', highlights: [{ boxes: [[12.5, 41.2, 38.0, 3.1]], at: 1.2 }], focus: { box: [12.5, 41.2, 38.0, 3.1], at: 2.0 } })

components.name: talking-head
components.description: Turns one portrait photo or illustration into a talking, blinking, breathing head. The face is rigged automatically from landmarks; the jaw and lips follow the narration or a dialogue line from the speak tool, eyes blink, the head sways and nods on words. Use for presenters, historical figures, interviews and character dialogue.

src.doc: image asset id of a front-facing portrait

lipsync.doc: 'voice' for the film narration or an audio asset id from speak

lipsyncAt.doc: scene seconds when that audio line starts

gain.doc: mouth opening strength (0.5 subtle to 1.6 expressive)

motion.doc: head sway and nod amount (0 still to 1 lively)

components.example: component('talking-head', { src: 'as_portrait01', lipsync: 'as_line0001', lipsyncAt: 0.6, x: 30, y: 8, w: 40, h: 84, frame: 'card' })

components.name: lens
components.description: Lens and camera look for the whole scene: fisheye, wide, telephoto, anamorphic (letterbox, streak flares), tilt-shift miniature, macro, vintage film (gate weave, dust, grain), VHS, CRT, security camera, camcorder viewfinder, dreamy, night vision. Adds lens moves: push-in, crash zoom, dolly zoom (vertigo) and rack focus between two elements. Overlays: vignette, chromatic aberration, flares, light leaks, dust, grain, bokeh, scanlines, letterbox, REC frame.

overlays.doc: extra overlays: vignette, chromatic, flare, leaks, dust, grain, bokeh, scanlines, letterbox, rec, glow, circle

zoom.doc: end zoom for push, crash and dolly

focusA.doc: rack focus: CSS selector sharp first

focusB.doc: rack focus: CSS selector sharp after the rack

tint.doc: extra CSS filter for the colour look

components.example: component('lens', { type: 'anamorphic', move: 'push', zoom: 1.12, focus: [40, 45] })

components.name: toon
components.description: Story cartoon character in the bold outlined style of animated story channels: big white round head, expressive brows and eyes, coloured body, stick limbs. Build any cast from presets (kid, teen-girl, teen-boy, old-man, old-woman, police, soldier, doctor, nurse, teacher, scientist, businessman, chef, biker, beekeeper, thief, zombie, hero, firefighter, astronaut, pirate, wizard, king, queen, princess, ninja, farmer, artist, detective, graduate, builder, viking, mail-carrier, singer, athlete, photographer) or from parts (hats, hair, beards, extras, props, colours, custom SVG parts). Acts with walk, run, shamble, wave, point, talk with lip sync, shock, cheer, scared, cry, laugh, fall, hug and more, each with an expression.

preset.doc: starting look; any field below overrides it

y.doc: feet baseline in % of frame height

h.doc: character height in % of frame height

skin.doc: face and hands colour (default white like a cartoon; zombie green)

hat.doc: empty keeps the preset; none removes it

extras.doc: backpack, cape, tie, bowtie, badge, scarf, apron, stethoscope, vest, belt, sash, necklace, glasses, sunglasses, eyepatch, bandage, freckles, scar, earrings (colours: capeColor, tieColor, scarfColor, vestColor, beltColor, sashColor, gemColor, backpackColor)

zombie.doc: undead look and default shamble pose

depth.doc: 0 foreground to 1 far background (blur and darken)

actions.doc: [{do: walk|run|shamble (with to: x%), wave, point (dir), talk, look (dir), shock, jump, cheer, shrug, nod, shake, think, scared, cry, laugh, angry, crouch, fall, hold, raise, hug, turn, pull, at, duration, expression}]

lipsync.doc: 'voice' or an audio asset id from speak

parts.doc: custom SVG markup in the 240x480 rig space: {head, body, prop, front}; head parts move with the head, prop with the hand

components.example: component('toon', { preset: 'teen-girl', x: 30, shirt: '#d94b3d', prop: 'flashlight', actions: [{ do: 'run', at: 0.3, duration: 2, to: 60, expression: 'scared' }, { do: 'look', dir: 'left', at: 2.4, duration: 1 }] })

components.name: toon-crowd
components.description: A crowd of toon characters (people or zombies) in depth rows: each one is varied (colours, hair, hats, speed, sway), they shamble, walk or mill around. Use for zombie hordes, protests, audiences, city streets.
components.example: component('toon-crowd', { count: 14, zombie: true, rows: 3, move: 'shamble', dir: 'right', at: 0.2 })

components.name: toon-prop
components.description: A cartoon object or building in the toon style (thick ink outline, flat colours) that lives and moves: smoke from chimneys and fires, flickering lit windows, blinking antennas, spinning windmills and rotors, rolling wheels, swaying trees, siren lights, opening gates. Vehicles can drive to a position. Objects: house, apartment, tower, shop, pharmacy, hospital, school, church, factory, tent, cabin, bridge, gate, fence, barricade, wall, car, police-car, bus, truck, bicycle, boat, helicopter, plane, tree, pine, palm, bush, rock, lamp, traffic-light, billboard, sign, bench, table, chair, bed, sofa, tv, computer, desk, door, window, beehive, campfire, fire, radio, barrel, crate, radio-tower, water-tower, windmill, mountain, cloud, sun, moon, well, mailbox, hydrant, trash-can, satellite-dish, fridge, stove, counter, sink, dining-table, kitchen-shelf, wardrobe, bookshelf, floor-lamp, rug, curtains, window-frame, painting, clock, potted-plant, armchair, coffee-table, bathtub, toilet, desk-lamp, laptop, blackboard, whiteboard, lockers, school-desk, office-chair, filing-cabinet, swing, slide, fountain, statue, flower-bed, mushroom, snowman, food-truck, market-stall, bus-stop, train, ship, rocket.

open.doc: gate: scene seconds when it opens

burning.doc: adds flames and smoke on top

parts.doc: extra SVG markup in the object coordinate space

components.example: component('toon-prop', { name: 'pharmacy', x: 70, y: 86, h: 38, night: true })

components.name: toon-set
components.description: A complete animated environment behind toon characters: sky by time of day (stars and moon at night, sun by day), a far parallax layer (skyline with lit windows, mountains, hills, dunes, sea), living mid-ground objects and buildings, and a ground line. Presets: city-night, city-day, burning-city, street, suburb, rooftop, forest, desert, beach, mountains, farm, interior, office, bridge, checkpoint, campsite, kitchen, bedroom, living-room, bathroom, classroom, office-open, park, playground, market, bus-station, harbor, launchpad, winter-village, fairy-forest, train-station, hospital-front, school-yard, church-square, factory, airport, downtown-night, rainy-street, countryside-road, lakeside, island, snowy-forest, night-forest, garden, museum, library, restaurant, cafe, studio-apartment, science-lab, police-station, construction-site, sunset-beach, desert-night, space-center. Add weather (rain, snow, fog), burning, a slow camera pan, extra props.

pan.doc: camera pan speed in px per second (parallax); negative pans left

ground.doc: ground line in % of frame height

props.doc: replace the preset objects: [[name, x%, h%, {options}]]

components.example: component('toon-set', { preset: 'burning-city', weather: 'ash', pan: 10 })

components.name: world3d
components.description: Procedural 3D world built entirely in code (no model files): a set (studio, lab with a Tesla coil, battlefield with castle and catapult, suburb street, living room, forest, city at night, space), a cast of stylised 3D characters made from primitives (presets scientist, soldier, knight, kid, teen-girl, teen-boy, businessman, chef, old-man, hero, astronaut, zombie, farmer, robot; any hair, hat, outfit, props, expressive painted faces) that act on a timeline with the same actions as toon, effects (lightning, fireball, explosion, tornado, debris, sparks, confetti, rain, snow, dust, embers) and a directed camera (shots, moves, automatic shake). Looks: lowpoly (faceted 3D cartoon), felt (stop-motion fabric with stitches and button joints), clay (claymation), toy (glossy plastic), paper (cardstock on threes). Works in 16:9, 9:16 and 1:1.

at.doc: start time in scene seconds (the world is visible from the first frame by default)

set.doc: environment; none gives a transparent background

look.doc: material and motion style for the whole world

time.doc: lighting and sky; empty uses the set default

props.doc: ModelSpec set dressing: [{model: library name (dog, cat, bird, car, tree, house, chair, table, desk-lamp, sofa) or a ModelSpec object, x, z, yaw, scale, colors}]

cast.doc: a cast member may be a ModelSpec creature or object instead of a person: {id, model: 'dog' or a spec, x, z, facing, scale, colors, actions: walk/run (to), wag, nod, spin, joint}. People: characters: [{id, preset, x, z, facing (degrees, 0 faces camera), scale, skin, hair (short|side|spiky|messy|ponytail|bun|long|curly|bald), hairColor, hat (helmet|cap|hardhat|chef|beanie|crown|tophat|straw|space|none), hatColor, shirt, pants, shoes, outfit (casual|labcoat|armor|hoodie|suit|overalls|suit-space|robot), extras [goggles, glasses, backpack, cape, beard, mustache], prop (sword|shield|wrench|phone|book|cup|torch|flashlight|sign|umbrella|briefcase|flask), propL, expression, actions: [{do, at, duration, to: x or [x,z], dir, expression, height}]}]. Actions: walk, run, march, sneak, wave, point, talk, look, shock, jump, cheer, shrug, nod, shake, think, scared, cry, laugh, angry, yell, crouch, brace, block, attack, punch, throw, fall, fly, tumble, blown-away, hold, raise, hug, sit, dance, turn, type, zap. Expressions: neutral, happy, sad, angry, worried, shocked, scared, smirk, laugh, determined, sleepy, zombie, love, thinking, yell, excited

fx.doc: effects: [{type: lightning|fireball|explosion|tornado|debris|sparks|confetti|rain|snow|dust|embers, at, duration, from, to (cast id, anchor name like coil/castle, or [x,y,z]), pos, count, arc, size}]

camera.doc: {shot: extreme|wide|full|medium|close|extremeclose|low|high|ots, target: cast id or [x,y,z], yaw: degrees around the target, orbit: degrees across the scene, push: end zoom like 1.15, moves: [{at, duration, shot, target, yaw}], shake: 0 to 2}

steps.doc: animate on 1s, 2s or 3s (stop-motion); 0 uses the look default

boil.doc: stop-motion jitter amount 0 to 2; -1 uses the look default

set_options.doc: set details: {color (studio backdrop), sofa, wall, coil: [x,z], castle: [x,z], catapult: [x,z]}

components.example: component('world3d', { set: 'lab', look: 'lowpoly', cast: [{ id: 'doc', preset: 'scientist', x: -0.6, z: 0.6, facing: 20, actions: [{ do: 'shock', at: 1.2, duration: 1.4 }] }], fx: [{ type: 'lightning', at: 0.8, duration: 3, to: 'doc' }], camera: { shot: 'medium', target: 'doc', yaw: -18, push: 1.15 } })

components.name: figure3d
components.description: One procedural 3D character (no model file) on a transparent background with a soft shadow, to drop over any 2D scene: same presets, outfits, props, faces, actions and looks (lowpoly, felt, clay, toy, paper) as world3d.
components.example: component('figure3d', { preset: 'kid', look: 'felt', x: 30, y: 10, w: 40, h: 85, actions: [{ do: 'shock', at: 0.5, duration: 1.2 }] })

components.name: model-spec
components.description: A 3D model generated from a ModelSpec: a JSON list of named parts (box, cylinder, cone, sphere, capsule, torus, lathe, loft, tube, gable) attached to each other by anchors, with templates (head, torso, limb, tail, wheel, roof, canopy, eye), mirroring, named joints and materials. Use a library model by name (dog, cat, bird, car, tree, house, chair, table, desk-lamp, sofa) or write your own spec for any character, animal, vehicle, building, furniture or prop. Validation rejects single-blob models and floating parts. Animate with walk, run, wag, nod, flap, spin or a named joint.

spec.doc: a ModelSpec object (see the procedural-3d-world skill)

actions.doc: [{do: walk|run|wag|nod|flap|spin|joint, at, duration, joint, to, amount}]

components.example: component('model-spec', { model: 'dog', x: 20, y: 15, w: 60, h: 70, actions: [{ do: 'walk', at: 0, duration: 3 }, { do: 'wag', at: 3, duration: 2 }] })

components.name: stickman
components.description: Stick figure actor drawn as one clean ink line (classic, filled head, chalk, neon or marker style) with a real rig: arms posed by angle, legs solved with IK so feet stay planted, walk and run cycles driven by distance travelled (no foot sliding), squash-and-stretch jumps with anticipation and landing, moods (flat, happy, sad, shock, curious, grit) with natural blinks, optional beanie and shirt colour, plus impact bursts and a short stage shake. Same action list style as toon.

y.doc: ground line in % of frame height

h.doc: figure height in % of frame height

shirt.doc: shirt colour drawn behind the torso line

actions.doc: [{do: walk|run (to: x%), wave, point (dir up), talk, cheer, shock, double-take, think, shrug, punch, kick, fall, nod, shake, crouch, jump (height), at, duration, expression}]

impacts.doc: [{at, x, y}] burst of speed strokes plus a 0.16 s stage shake at each contact

components.example: component('stickman', { x: 30, actions: [{ do: 'walk', at: 0.2, duration: 1.6, to: 55 }, { do: 'shock', at: 2, duration: 1 }], impacts: [{ at: 2.0 }] })

components.name: speech
components.description: Speech, thought or shout bubble that follows a character: it finds the speaker every frame (toon, toon-animal or stickman by its layer name, or a world3d cast id), sits above the head with its tail pointing down, never covers a face and stays inside the safe area. Text uses the film type scale.

target.doc: layer name of the toon, toon-animal or stickman, or a world3d cast id

maxw.doc: max width in % of frame width

components.example: component('speech', { target: 'mia', text: 'Biscuit? Where are you?', at: 0.6, duration: 1.8 })

components.name: toon-animal
components.description: Cartoon animal in the same bold outlined style as toon: dog, cat, rabbit, fox, pig, bird, bear, mouse, lion, sheep, cow, horse or panda with expressive face, collar and spots. Acts with walk, run, sniff (with to: x%), sit, lie, sleep, jump, wag, happy, bark, eat, look, sad, beg and shock. Use for pets and animal characters in toon stories.

y.doc: ground line in % of frame height

h.doc: animal height in % of frame height

actions.doc: [{do: walk|run|sniff (to: x%), sit, lie, sleep, jump, wag, happy, bark, eat, look (dir), sad, beg, shock, at, duration, expression}]

components.example: component('toon-animal', { species: 'dog', x: 70, color: '#C98B4E', collar: '#D32F2F', actions: [{ do: 'run', at: 0.4, duration: 1.6, to: 40 }, { do: 'wag', at: 2.2, duration: 1.5 }] })

components.name: anime-face
components.description: Anime close-up: a cel-painted bust with large eyes (sclera, iris, pupil, two window catchlights), two or three hair masses with one hard sheen band, one hard shadow shape and tapered ink line, in a closed colour script. Acts on twos: talk with lip sync, blink, discrete head turns with hair follow-through, looks, shock, cry, shout, laugh, blush. Use for close-ups and reaction shots in anime films; pair with anime-figure for wide and action shots using the same hair, colours and outfit.

script.doc: colour script: the closed palette for the whole film

x.doc: centre of the bust in % of frame width

y.doc: bottom of the bust in % of frame height

h.doc: bust height in % of frame height (92 close-up, 60 medium close-up)

turn.doc: -1 looks left of frame, 0 front, 1 right

wind.doc: 0 to 1: hair and scarf sway on twos

actions.doc: [{do: talk|blink|turn (to)|look (dir)|nod|shock|cry|shout|laugh|blush|tilt, at, duration, expression, hold}]; expressions cut on the drawing, never tween

enter.doc: anime characters cut in with the shot; they never fade in

components.example: component('anime-face', { layer: 'ren', script: 'indigo', hair: 'messy', hairColor: '#191720', iris: '#e3a04b', outfit: 'coat', accessory: 'scarf', x: 38, turn: 0.4, actions: [{ do: 'talk', at: 0.4, duration: 1.6 }, { do: 'turn', at: 2.2, to: -0.2 }, { do: 'shock', at: 2.6, duration: 0.8 }] })

components.name: anime-figure
components.description: Anime full-body character in limited animation: discrete key drawings held on twos (walk and run cycles, crouch, leap, land, windup, strike with a one-frame smear, follow-through, wave, reach, point, kneel, hit, sit), never tweened between poses. Same hair, colours and outfit as anime-face so the character matches across shot sizes. Wide shots draw it as a flat silhouette with a rim line.

preset.doc: ready-made character look; any hair, outfit or colour you set overrides it

script.doc: colour script: the closed palette for the whole film

x.doc: feet centre in % of frame width

y.doc: ground line in % of frame height

h.doc: figure height in % of frame height

silhouette.doc: auto draws figures under 32% of frame height as flat silhouettes, the way wide anime shots do

actions.doc: [{do: walk|run (to: x%)|strike|slash (anticipation 4 frames, smear 2 frames, hold)|jump (height, to)|wave|talk|turn (dir)|hit|reach|point|kneel|lookup|crossed|fist|sit|crouch|stand, at, duration, expression, hold: true}]

enter.doc: anime characters cut in with the shot; they never fade in

components.example: component('anime-figure', { layer: 'ren', script: 'indigo', hair: 'messy', outfit: 'coat', accessory: 'scarf', x: 20, h: 64, actions: [{ do: 'run', at: 0.2, duration: 1.4, to: 55 }, { do: 'strike', at: 1.8, duration: 1.2, to: 68, hold: true }] })

components.name: anime-set
components.description: Painted anime background in a closed colour script: sky gradient, moon or sun, layered skylines with lit practical windows, hills, shrine, classroom, bedroom, rainy street, seaside, sakura path, ruins, open sky or a void for action. Weather runs on ones or twos from seeded positions, an optional 100 to 106 percent push holds the shot, and letterbox bars frame cinematic shots.

script.doc: colour script: the closed palette for the whole film

weather.doc: rain and embers on ones, snow and petals on twos; positions are seeded

push.doc: camera push across the shot, 1.06 at most (only on holds; cut closer instead of zooming)

components.example: component('anime-set', { preset: 'rooftop', script: 'indigo', weather: 'rain', push: 1.06, letterbox: true })

components.name: anime-fx
components.description: Anime effects drawn as flat shapes on ones: parallel speed lines or radial focus lines that flicker every frame, a two-frame impact burst, a tapered blade slash with a trailing smear, sparks and a full-frame flash. Use them inside the one sakuga action shot, not everywhere.

script.doc: colour script: the closed palette for the whole film

type.doc: speedlines and focus lines flicker on ones; impact and flash last two frames

angle.doc: direction of travel for speedlines and slash, degrees

components.example: component('anime-fx', { type: 'slash', x: 62, y: 46, angle: -20, at: 1.9, duration: 0.3 })

components.name: fx
components.description: Overlay effects for the whole frame: light leaks, film grain, VHS, glitch, old film, CRT scanlines, vignette, flash, light rays, sparkles, confetti, rain, snow, embers, bokeh, stars, dust, lens flare, camera shake, zoom punch, HUD frame, halftone, letterbox bars and RGB split. Deterministic per frame.

color.doc: tint colour for light leak, flash, rays, sparkles, HUD (hex or --var)

components.example: component('fx', { kind: 'light-leak', at: 0, intensity: 1 })

components.name: intro
components.description: Full-frame intro, outro and title card designs: neon flicker, line draw, minimal slide, shapes assemble, colour burst, iridescent, retro 80s, glitch reveal, split reveal, countdown, terminal, cinematic, ink reveal, kinetic stack, light sweep, end card. Uses the film palette and fonts.

logo.doc: optional image asset id shown above the title

dark.doc: dark backdrop (false uses the film background colour)

components.example: component('intro', { style: 'neon-flicker', title: 'Night Shift', subtitle: 'A short film', at: 0 })
